literal_meaning: গুড়ের মধ্যে বালি (jaggery mixed with sand)
figurative_meaning_en: hope turning into disappointment, dashed expectations
similar_in_english: all that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: আশা করেছিলাম সাহায্য পাব, কিন্তু সে গুড়ে বালি প্রমাণিত হলো।
তার প্রতিশ্রুতি গুড়ে বালি, কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I hoped for help, but it turned out to be sand in jaggery.
His promises are like sand in jaggery—utterly disappointing.
note: Refers to something that appears sweet and beneficial but is actually worthless or harmful, drawing from everyday rural experiences with impure jaggery.
